capabilities: Read, search, write, and organize files, folders, and vault apps in shared vault Surfaces, with every earlier version kept.
description: Finds vault folders and files whose paths match a glob, relative to path (default "/"): * and ? within one name, ** across folders, [abc] for one of several characters, and {a,b} for alternatives, such as "**/*.pdf". Matching ignores case. Returns at most 200 paths, most recently changed first, folders ending in /. Files inside artifacts are not matched; list an artifact with list_vault.

path.description: The folder to search below; defaults to the root

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

name: glob_vault
